name: Slovakia: Part II package and CTIS upload check
applies_to: the Slovakia package as a whole (plan-level checklist step)

items.check: K1 recruitment and informed-consent procedure present, on EudraLex template v2.0, with the Slovak Member State fields and a section for every population pathway in the plan.
K2 recruitment material present for every advertisement or invitation used in Slovakia.
One L1 information and consent set per population in population_sets whose trigger is true; every enrolled age and decision-maker has a document pathway.
L2 other patient-facing material only where the CTR or current Commission Q&A requires it; endpoint-related documents on the Q&A route.
For every Slovak site: M1 CV, M2 declaration of interest and N1 Slovakia national site suitability form.
M3 list of Slovak sites and principal investigators present.
O1 valid insurance certificate for Slovakia and the expected conduct period.
P1 compensation form present.
GDPR compliance statement completed in the CTIS Form section.
S1 biological-samples form present.
GMO authorisation included.
Authorisation for investigational radioactive medicinal products or precursors included.
Transplant-centre authorisation for each site concerned.
Only dossier documents permitted by the Clinical Trials Regulation and the current Q&A are uploaded (no bulk upload of diaries, cards, questionnaires or instructions).
Every participant- or representative-facing document is in Slovak and complete and understandable.
English and Slovak patient-facing versions convey the same meaning and share version and date.
Administrative documents are in Slovak (K1 and M1 may be bilingual Slovak and English).
Blank consent forms contain no participant signatures; no signatures on K1, K2, L, M, M3, N1 (CTIS copy), P1 and S1 unless a current form expressly requires one.
Controlled signed source documents (CV, DoI, site suitability confirmation, signed consents later) are retained in the appropriate trial file.
Each Slovak site appears in CTIS, the investigator list (M3) and its own site suitability form (N1).
Protocol number, EU trial number, sponsor and document version are consistent across all documents.
Travel reimbursement and participant contacts (including the national Ethics Committee telephone route) are stated in the participant documents and match P1.
Insurance wording in the participant documents matches the valid Slovakia certificate.
Data flows, recipients, transfers and retention identical in the GDPR statement, participant documents and protocol.
Sample types, storage, transfers and retention identical in S1, the protocol and the participant documents; optional sample or data use separated from main-trial consent.
Consent pathways in K1 match the L1 sets in the package.
Documents adapted from the reference package contain the Slovak national additions and no leftovers from the reference country.
items.applies_when: Slovakia is not the reference package

items.check: Correct B–S section prefix and CTIS placeholder for each document; GDPR statement in the Form section.
Unique, self-explanatory title of at most 100 characters: <section code>_<document type>_<subtype>_<country>_<language>_<special attribute>.
Participant-document filenames carry a clear population and language label.
Version and date entered in CTIS metadata, not in the title.
Personal names only where disclosure permits (principal investigator in M1/M2).
Clean, tracked-change, redacted or public and split-file variants clearly distinguished.
Uploaded filename base contains none of ( ) / , . ; | [ ] (the period before the extension is fine).
Article 11 workaround: every mandatory Part II placeholder holds the official placeholder PDF titled Part_II_placeholder_document_Article_11_workaround.
items.applies_when: Slovakia receives Part I only under Article 11

items.check: For each document, publication status checked against the current Annex I publication tables (revised CTIS transparency rules applicable from 18 June 2024).
Publishable documents: personal data and CCI identified separately; public version redacts only qualifying material.
Public and assessment versions differ only by the intended redactions; each in the correct CTIS slot.
No personal data or CCI in public structured fields.
No drafting instruction remains in any document (see content/conventions/template-instructions.md).
Every final PDF opened and checked (page order, Slovak characters, selectable text, no comments or hidden content).
Every document approved by the owner in TrialAgents, or the user has explicitly chosen to export unapproved versions.
